Australia/Sydney offset = +10  
US/Hawaii offset = -10  
Difference = target_offset - source_offset = (-10) - (+10) = -20 hours.  
7 PM = 19:00.  
19:00 - 20 hours = -01:00 → 24:00 - 1:00 = 23:00 previous day.  
So September 23, 1095 19:00 Sydney → September 22, 1095 23:00 Hawaii.  

FINAL_ANSWER: September 22, 1095 23:00
